# Hawaii Vacation Packing List
## Emma Johnson's Hawaii Trip - June 10-20, 2024

### Clothing & Footwear
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Casual outfits for daily wear
- Hiking gear and comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals/flip-flops for beach days
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Sun hat and sunglasses
- Rain poncho (Hawaii can have sudden showers)

### Beach & Water Activities
- Sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- Reef-safe sunscreen (required in Hawaii)
- Beach towel
- Water shoes for snorkeling at Hanauma Bay
- Snorkel gear (or rent on-site)
- Waterproof phone case
- Dry bag for electronics and valuables

### Hiking & Outdoor Gear
- Diamond Head hiking gear (water bottle, trekking poles if needed)
- Daypack for hikes
- Insect repellent (mosquitoes can be present in some areas)
- First aid kit with basic supplies
- Sunscreen lip balm

### Electronics & Documentation
- Camera (and extra batteries/memory cards)
- Phone and charger
- Power bank for long days out
- Travel documents (passport, ID, insurance info)
- Printed itinerary and reservations
- Cash (small bills for tips and small purchases)

### Personal Items
- Toiletries (travel-sized)
- Medications (prescription and basic pain relievers)
- Glasses/contacts and case
- Jewelry or valuables to leave at home if possible

### Miscellaneous
- Reusable water bottle
- Snacks for hikes/beach days
- Book or entertainment for travel time
- Travel adapter (if needed for international use)
- Ziplock bags for wet items

---
*Created based on vacation-plans.docx and general Hawaii packing recommendations*

# Hawaii Vacation Packing List
## Emma Johnson's Hawaii Trip - June 10-20, 2024

### Clothing & Footwear
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Casual outfits for daily wear
- Hiking gear and comfortable walking shoes
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Sunglasses and hat for sun protection
- Flip-flops for beach days
- Comfortable sandals for exploring

### Sun Protection
- High SPF sunscreen (reef-safe preferred)
- After-sun lotion
- Lip balm with SPF
- Aloe vera gel for burns
- UV-protection clothing options

### Hiking & Outdoor Gear
- Diamond Head hiking gear (water bottle, trekking poles if needed)
- Daypack for hikes
- Rain jacket (Hawaii can have sudden showers)
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit with blister treatment

### Electronics
- Camera (and extra batteries/memory cards)
- Phone and charger
- Power bank for extended days out
- Waterproof phone case
- Drone if permitted at destinations

### Travel Documents & Essentials
- Passport/ID
- Travel insurance documents
- Flight tickets and hotel confirmations
- Rental car reservation details
- Emergency contact information
- Copies of important documents (digital and physical)

### Personal Items
- Toiletries (travel-sized)
- Medications (prescription and over-the-counter)
- Glasses/contacts with solution
- Jewelry or valuables to leave at home if possible

### Miscellaneous
- Reusable water bottle
- Snacks for hikes/beach days
- Beach towel
- Waterproof bag for electronics
- Local currency (though cards widely accepted)
- Travel journal and pen

---
*Created based on vacation plans document*
